room.name: [Jeol'gelvmoraen, Ice Grottos] (4217403)
room.description: Curiously mummified creatures, contorted into odd postures by the slow movement of the ice, rest beneath the surface of the walls and floor. Their baleful eyes gaze blankly from behind the faceted flow, almost pleading for release from their frigid tombs. A tracery of faint cracks emanates from beneath a twisted stone that has fallen from the ceiling; an oval of tortuous white imperfections marks the collision, stark upon a sea of blue ice.
